shortDescription: The probability of the “Yes” option in Polymarket’s “Stephen Curry: Points O/U 19.5” sub-market for “Pelicans vs. Warriors” rose to 82.5% from 44.5% an hour earlier, a 38% increase. According to ChainCatcher, the market saw a sharp fluctuation.
